name: Annapolis
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Annapolis for 2026, and here is what he found: 17 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Annapolis Gingerbread Houses) through January 6 (Annapolis Gingerbread Houses), with the Grand Illumination (November 29), 1776: Yuletide in Revolutionary Annapolis (December 5) and the Eastport Yacht Club Lights Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Annapolis

  • 17 Christmas events for kids in Annapolis
  • 4 free events, including the Crofton Holiday Tree Lighting and Santa Is Coming to Crofton at Crofton Library
  • Meet Santa: Cookies & Cocoa with Claus at Children's Theatre of Annapolis, Saturday with Santa at St. Stephen's Church in Crownsville and the Odenton Christmas Tree Lighting
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Grand Illumination (November 29), the Crofton Holiday Tree Lighting (December 7), the Odenton Christmas Tree Lighting (December 5) and the Eastport Yacht Club Lights Parade (December 12)
  • Lights: Lights on the Bay at Sandy Point State Park and the North Pole Lights Walk at Willow Oak Flower & Herb Farm
  • Season: November 21, 2026 to January 6, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Annapolis families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Baltimore, which covers the Polar Express Train Ride at the B&O Railroad Museum, the Mayor's Christmas Parade, Christmas Village at the Inner Harbor and Holly Days at the Maryland Zoo.
